title: Shiller (KOL)
description: An X account that posted a contract address (`kols` table), with the statistics the dashboard computes from its mentions and outcomes. The stats block mirrors the dashboard query in web/src/lib/server/queries/shillers.ts. Source: backend/migrations/0001_init.sql, 0002, 0008, 0011.

twitter_id.description: Stable X user id. Handles can change; identity is kept on this id.

smart_followers_count.description: Smart followers (SMARTS) from Frontrun; null until fetched.

smart_followers_final.description: Frontrun `meta.resolved`: false means the count was still being computed and is refreshed within a day.

tracked.description: True once the author passed the follower threshold (`KOL_MIN_FOLLOWERS`, 1000) or was added otherwise; tracked shillers get CA history and wallet lookups.

first_seen_at.description: When Kairos first stored this account.

last_mention_at.description: Time of the most recent tweet with a CA.

stats.description: Derived statistics. They are computed on read, not stored in `kols`. Outcome counts use first-mention outcomes at 24 h under rule set v2, with the attribution rule (only tokens this shiller mentioned within 60 minutes of the token's first mention).

ca_count.description: Distinct contract addresses this shiller posted, including tokens not yet in `tokens`.

calls.description: Distinct known tokens this shiller mentioned.

finals.description: Calls with a final label (`success`, `rug`, `dead` or `neutral`) that count for this shiller.

median_entry_minute.description: Median minutes from token creation to this shiller's first call, over tokens with a reliable creation time.

win_rate.description: wins / finals; null when finals is 0.

rug_rate.description: rugs / finals; null when finals is 0.

wilson_lower_bound.description: Lower bound of the 95% Wilson interval of the win rate. Used to rank shillers; 0 when finals is 0.

hold.description: On-chain holding behaviour from the `kol_hold_stats` view (migration 0012). Zeros and nulls when no wallet trades are tracked.

positions.description: Positions (wallet + mint) with a first buy.

median_hold_s.description: Median seconds from first buy to first sell.

fast_dump_share.description: Share of closed positions held under 60 seconds.

wallets.description: Wallets linked to this shiller (`kol_wallets` joined with `wallets`). Public addresses only.

relation.description: How the wallet is linked to the account, as reported by Frontrun or added by hand.
